name: Scrapling
description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev
one_liner: A toolkit that makes it much easier to pull structured data off websites, even ones that actively try to block scrapers.
buyer: A small e-commerce or market-research business that needs ongoing competitor price or product data but can't afford a custom scraping team.
business_use_cases: A price-intelligence agency builds a service tracking competitor prices across hundreds of retail sites for small e-commerce clients.
A real-estate data startup scrapes listing sites nightly to feed a 'new listings alert' product for local agents.
A lead-generation business scrapes public directories and marketplaces to build niche contact lists it sells to sales teams.

money_ideas.idea: A managed 'data-as-a-service' subscription delivering a specific scraped dataset (prices, listings, leads) on a recurring schedule.
One-off custom scraping projects sold to businesses that need a single dataset pulled once.

steal_this: Pick one niche (e.g. local rental listings) and this weekend build a scraper that emails a client a fresh spreadsheet every morning — sell that as a $50/month micro-service.
